entities.summary: Anqing Normal University , it is the first and only provincial normal university in the southwest of Anhui Province, China. The university is a national base for cultural quality education of college students, an advanced unit in national spiritual civilization construction, a national base for the inheritance of Chinese excellent traditional culture, and an advanced unit in school art education. It is also a school selected for the construction of basic capabilities in central and western China.
